scheduleSemantics: Steps are ordered directives; offsetSeconds delays from the prior step. The executor reads the complete schedule before execution: CRASH_RESTART names workerHook=release and crashPoint, arms that hook BEFORE the immediately preceding RELEASE, then restarts at CRASH_RESTART. The following RELEASE retries before original expiry. Hooks are closed test controls, not code. ADVANCE_CLOCK uses the qualification boundary. E1 materializes local bindings; no run is asserted.
